goal: FedRAMP 20x Class C certification of NINELINE on the Program path

milestones.title: Optimal signing infrastructure in AWS GovCloud (US)
milestones.detail: Release and vulnerability-database signing key in KMS, signing roles limited to the release workflow, signing log in CloudTrail.

milestones.title: FedRAMP Marketplace listing request submitted
milestones.detail: Certification Package Overview published in FedRAMP's JSON schema and the listing request submitted (FRC-APP-MLF, MKT-CSO-PML); received by the FedRAMP Intake Team.

milestones.title: Listed on the FedRAMP Marketplace as Initial Implementation
milestones.detail: After FedRAMP's JSON schema validation and human review of the listing request.

milestones.title: Authorization boundary foundation and daily KSI validation
milestones.detail: Audit logging into immutable storage, AWS Config with the FedRAMP Moderate conformance pack, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector, and automated daily validation of all 46 Key Security Indicators.

milestones.title: NINELINE hosted inside the boundary
milestones.detail: The service behind WAF in a network with an egress allowlist, sign-in with MFA, DNSSEC-signed domain, model inference on Amazon Bedrock.

milestones.title: Change control enforced in source control
milestones.detail: Repository on GitHub Enterprise Cloud with required review and required checks on every change.

milestones.title: 30 days of persistent KSI validation data
milestones.detail: The daily metrics and summaries the Security Decision Record carries (SDR-CSX-KMT).

milestones.title: Independent assessment scheduled
milestones.detail: A FedRAMP Recognized assessor with no advisory role in the prior two years (REC-IAS-SEP).

milestones.title: FedRAMP 20x Class C certification application
milestones.detail: Certification package (CPO and SDR) and assessment submitted to FedRAMP.
